data.overview: Grounded image-anchored tasks favor one-pass block drafting, while free-running captioning/TextVQA favor autoregressive chain drafting. GLANCE reaches 2.93x AR speedup on ChartQA and exceeds production EAGLE3-VL on all three grounded tasks, but is slower on the two open tasks.

negative_results.name: Free-running text loses
negative_results.description: captioning: GLANCE 1.81x vs AR but EAGLE3-VL 2.16x; TextVQA GLANCE 2.02x vs EAGLE3-VL 2.49x. Deep block candidates drift when token dependencies are not image-pinned.

negative_results.name: Short-answer no amortization
negative_results.description: ScienceQA single-letter outputs fall below parity; method targets generation rather than classification.

negative_results.name: Long context parity
negative_results.description: around 6.7K context same-engine CUDA-graph comparison is -2.3% with CI spanning zero; GLANCE acceptance declines more than EAGLE3-VL.

negative_results.name: Graph capture dependency
negative_results.description: at 2K, CUDA graph converts saved draft passes to +5.8% margin; eager mode is roughly parity (-1.0%, CI spans zero).

data.interpretation: The speedup comes from removing sequential draft depth and exploiting low-entropy grounded spans with wide trees. Vision is an inherited source of predictability rather than repeated drafter overhead.
data.quality_impact: Greedy quality is unchanged by construction/audit; a weak draft affects only acceptance. Sampling preserves distribution rather than byte identity.
